WELCOME_SUB: Suo Rekupa Simba Africa Kuburikidza nePi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Mukucherechedza Zuva rechi25 reAfrica, iyi App yeKudzidzisa Mapiyona ePi yakavhurwa)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network ipurojekiti yemari yedhijitari uye ecosystem yepasi rose yakagadzirirwa kuita kuti cryptocurrency iwanikwe uye ibatsire kune wese.
INTRO_P2: Kusiyana nemari yechinyakare yecrypto inowanzoda michina inodhura yemigodhi nemagetsi akawanda, Pi Network inobvumira vanhuwo zvavo kuti vatore chikamu zvakananga kubva kumafoni avo.
INTRO_P3: Chiono chePi Network ndechekuvaka ecosystem inotungamirwa nevanhu uko mari yedhijitari inogona kushandiswa kushandiswa chaiko, masevhisi chaiwo, nharaunda chaidzo uye kutora chikamu kwehupfumi chaiko.
M1: Kuvaka hupfumi hwedhijitari hunosanganisira munhu wese
M2: Kupa simba vanhuwo zvavo pasi rose
CH1_SUB: Tikugamuchira kuNzvimbo Yedzidzo yeMapiyona eAfrica - Kunze. Puratifomu iyi yakagadzirirwa kudzidzisa, kupa simba nekugadzirira mapiyona eAfrica nemabhizinesi kuti atore chikamu chine musoro muPi Ecosystem.
DAILY_MINING: Kuchera Kwemazuva Ose: Dzoka maawa makumi maviri nemana oga oga kuti urambe uchichera.
WALLET_SEC: Kuchengetedzeka kweWallet: Usambofa wakagovana mazwi ako makumi maviri nemana ePassphrase. Ani naani ane mazwi iwayo ndiye muridzi wechikwama.
CH2_DESC: Dzidza magamuchiriro neku kutumira Pi zvakachengeteka uchishandisa Pi Wallet muPi Browser.
CH2A_DESC: Tanga nemari shoma yekuyedza, simbisa kero, usatombogovana passphrase yako.
CH3_DESC: Pi Browser DApps zvikumbiro zvakatemerwa zvekushandisa chaiko.
CH4_DESC: Tsvaga mabhizinesi anogamuchira Pi pasi rose.
CH5_DESC: Global Consensus Value inokurudzira kushandiswa chaiko muecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Dzidza bhuku raDoris Yin rekugadzira mashandisirwo nekukura kweecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Maitiro ekujoinha ecosystem, kunyora bhizinesi rako paMapOfPi, kugamuchira mubhadharo wePi.
FINAL_P: Africa ine mukana wekuva imwe yenzvimbo dzakasimba kwazvo mukushandiswa kunoshanda mukati mePi Ecosystem. Pamwe chete Tinovaka. Pamwe chete Tinodzidzisa. Pamwe chete Tinopa Simba Africa Kuburikidza nePi.
